payload.friendly_name: ADRs as first-class docs: lifecycle-mapped statuses and a generated status taxonomy
payload.purpose_context: Drafting ADR-0009 was rejected by the pre-commit validator for a status the ADR README itself documents as valid. Investigation found three files enumerating doc status with only one enforced (two had already drifted), a fourth divergent set in the ADR README, and ADR lifecycle states — superseded, partially superseded, has-erratum — that the taxonomy cannot express and that are currently smuggled into prose in a separate index file. Kent ruled 2026-09-18 that ADRs are now first-class persistent-memory and coordination artifacts and need statuses matching their lifecycle. Tracked as kentonium3/kg-automation#987.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give ADRs a status set that maps to their real lifecycle, scope status values by doc_type, and generate the unenforced status copies from the one enforced source so the taxonomy cannot drift.
